interpretation: The exact legacy multiscale implementation produced 1269 independent executable candidates, so the prior 202-trade simplified strategy was not a valid substitute.

The candidate pool recalls a material right tail, including 118 paths above 50 percent MFE and 23 above 100 percent, but fixed-40-day Alpha is negative overall, in six of seven training years, and in every market-outcome bucket.

Exit tuning cannot repair the negative fixed-horizon selection Alpha. The strategy remains useful as a broad candidate generator, but its default executable status is not promoted to a complete strategy.
stopped_variants: test-period or market-regime selection from these results
next_action: Before any new trade rule, audit the legacy detector's scale and setup-stage composition using training candidates only. Register one structural entry hypothesis only if a pre-signal semantic subgroup explains the negative bulk while preserving right-tail recall.
